northpoint: Make every AI conversation, project, idea, status, artifact, and recovery path instantly findable without slowing or altering the provider experience.
pillars: Project Constellation is a standalone, recoverable product with one canonical local workspace and one canonical GitHub repository
performance work is bounded, visibility-aware, idle-scheduled, and never adds provider-page network traffic
execution reporting names only observable browser activity, distinguishes agent-bearing work from ordinary site traffic, and never invents hidden reasoning or fake-success health
conversation continuation is user-triggered, checkpointed, non-destructive, lineage-preserving, and available before provider capacity becomes an emergency
provider-side output regression cannot erase a richer captured assistant revision; recovery remains local, non-destructive, and truthful about which media bytes are durable
provider support is truthful, selector-resilient, permission-minimal, and tested against current public site behavior
OAuth is explicit, refresh-safe, least-privilege, secret-free in source, and never reports success before account verification
local storage, Google Drive continuity, GitHub backup, recovery, and upgrade paths preserve exact source lineage
the Nightfall visual system is accessible, restrained, GPU-friendly, reduced-motion aware, and unmistakably Project Constellation
documentation, wiki, release artifacts, checksums, repository metadata, and Project Brain agree with the verified build
guardrails: never trim, hide, replace, or second-virtualize provider conversation turns
content scripts never issue provider or OAuth network requests
observation and extraction work stays bounded, deduplicated, batched, and idle-aware
native provider behavior wins on failure and unsupported access is reported honestly

Approval Autopilot remains explicit opt-in, prefers the provider's conversation-wide permission control, retries only within a bounded budget, and never records recovery until the visible approval surface clears
output comparison runs only on authoritative hydrated page tails, never prefetches remote media, and stays bounded during passive observation
OAuth client IDs are injected at build time; client secrets, access tokens, refresh tokens, browser profiles, and user exports are never committed
Google access remains limited to drive.file and GitHub access remains scoped to the user-authorized repository workflow
the stable manifest key and extension ID must not change without a coordinated Google OAuth migration
ProjectDump is historical input only; preserve its unrelated content and never resume current development from it

a production release requires a clean source commit, full verification, credentialed build, real signed-in OAuth acceptance, immutable checksums, GitHub release verification, and Drive round-trip verification
reduced-motion and constrained-device modes must disable or tone down decorative animation without reducing readability or functionality
